entry.title: MoonClaw Noetix simulation review task for First Trusted Square / Shackleton Rim rehearsal tile
entry.summary: noetix-e1-lab-01 review task links source model, walk, link poses, static support, dynamic stability, joint control, inertial/collision, and Rabbita playback; source collision tags 0, source inertial tags 0, hardware authority moonmoon-safety-gate-only

primary_task.objective: Review the Noetix endless moon-walk simulation evidence as one MoonClaw work packet before any stronger dynamics or hardware-authority claim.

inputs.summary: Moonrobo source model audit for Noetix URDF/profile metadata and missing collision/inertial tags.
Moonrobo proof that the Noetix finite trace prefix is a window over an endless one-direction gait.
Kinematic endless +x Noetix walk trace over Moonmoon terrain with URDF leg IK phases.
Moonrobo high-control dry-run command plan for the Noetix walk trace.
URDF-reference link-pose trace bound to the walk frames and contact probes.
Static COM/support report that explicitly remains review-only for dynamic walking.
Capture-point dynamic stability report that remains review-only without controller and inertia evidence.
Moonphys joint-control replay over Noetix gait phases and URDF joint limits.
Moonphys inertial/collision review report over Noetix mass assumptions, shape bounds, terrain collisions, and self-contact manifolds.
Rabbita playback for inspecting the walk and link-pose skeleton.

artifacts.producer: moon run cmd/main -- moonrobo noetix model json
artifacts.required_state: Moonrobo source model audit records URDF links, joints, visual geometry, joint limits, and missing inertial/collision tags
artifacts.current_state: 25 links; 24 joints; 24 URDF joint limits; 6 visual geometries; collision tags 0; inertial tags 0

artifacts.producer: moon run cmd/main -- moonrobo noetix model json && moon run cmd/main -- moonrobo noetix command json
artifacts.required_state: Cross-checks Moonmoon Noetix evidence against sibling Moonrobo robot.json and URDF source files
artifacts.current_state: 24 URDF joints, 24 limits, 6 visuals, 0 collision tags, 0 inertial tags, command limit 0.25 m/s

artifacts.producer: moon run cmd/main -- moonrobo noetix endless json
artifacts.required_state: Moonrobo evidence that the finite Noetix trace prefix is a window over an endless one-direction gait
artifacts.current_state: cycle 20 frames; frame 0 repeats at 20; forward offset 0.24 m; status endless-gait-window-verified

artifacts.producer: moon run cmd/main -- moonrobo noetix walk json
artifacts.required_state: endless +x Noetix trace with lunar gravity, contact probes, and URDF leg IK joint phases
artifacts.current_state: 32 frames over first-trusted-square-northeast-stepout-lola; axis +x; 24 referenced joints with bounded leg IK

artifacts.producer: moon run cmd/main -- moonrobo noetix command json
artifacts.required_state: Moonrobo high-control walk command plan segments the Noetix trace into dry-run approval windows
artifacts.current_state: 3 dry-run segments; max x 0.12 m/s; duration limit 1500 ms; executable false; status walk-command-dry-run-review

artifacts.producer: moon run cmd/main -- moonrobo noetix poses json
artifacts.required_state: URDF-reference link poses are present for each Noetix walk frame
artifacts.current_state: 32 frames; 25 links per frame; status review-only

artifacts.producer: moon run cmd/main -- moonrobo noetix stability json
artifacts.required_state: static support evidence is reviewed before any dynamic-walk or hardware claim
artifacts.current_state: 32/32 frames require support review; worst planar margin -0.035 m; status static-support-review
artifacts.blocking_reason: static COM support is review-only until dynamic stability, joint-control, inertia, and collision evidence clear

artifacts.producer: moon run cmd/main -- moonrobo noetix dynamics json
artifacts.required_state: capture-point dynamic stability evidence is reviewed before any stronger walking claim
artifacts.current_state: 32/32 frames require capture-point review; worst capture margin -0.10787682825643309 m; status dynamic-stability-review
artifacts.blocking_reason: capture-point evidence is review-only until joint-control, inertia, and collision evidence clear

artifacts.producer: moon run cmd/main -- moonrobo noetix control json
artifacts.required_state: Moonphys joint servo replay checks the Noetix gait phases against URDF limits and actuator power/work accounting
artifacts.current_state: 32 frames; 24 joints per frame; saturated frames 0; limit-review frames 0; max power 14.89777245658858 W; absolute work 31.759430501284008 J; status joint-control-assumption-review
artifacts.blocking_reason: joint-control evidence is review-only until servo gains, inertia, and hardware authority are validated

artifacts.producer: moon run cmd/main -- moonrobo noetix collision json
artifacts.required_state: Moonphys diagonal inertia, collision bounds, terrain collisions, contact torque, and conservative self-collision manifolds are present for review
artifacts.current_state: 32 frames; 8 shapes per frame; self-contact review frames 32; terrain-review frames 0; status inertial-collision-self-review
artifacts.blocking_reason: inertial/collision evidence is review-only until Moonrobo provides authoritative mass, inertia, and collision tags

artifacts.producer: scripts/build_rabbita_ui.sh
artifacts.required_state: Rabbita renders Noetix walk, link-pose skeleton, frame controls, and simulation-only authority
artifacts.current_state: Noetix panel consumes walk and link-pose JSON with skeleton playback

acceptance_criteria.description: Task links source model, walk, link poses, static support, dynamic stability, joint control, inertial/collision, and Rabbita playback evidence with concrete validation commands.
Source model audit records zero authoritative collision and inertial tags, keeping physics evidence in review.
Noetix source-model and command-plan evidence must stay synchronized with sibling Moonrobo robot.json and URDF facts.
Finite Noetix trace exports remain verified windows over a cyclic one-direction gait.
Static support review frames remain explicit blockers for dynamic walking evidence.
Joint-control evidence remains review-only until servo gains, inertia, and hardware authority are validated.
High-control walk command plan remains dry-run review evidence and never becomes executable hardware authority.
Inertial/collision evidence remains review-only until authoritative Moonrobo mass, inertia, and collision tags are available.
MoonRobo hardware_state remains HardwareDenied and authority remains moonmoon-safety-gate-only.
Task names authoritative Moonrobo mass, inertia, and collision tags as the next requirement before stronger simulation claims.

primary_task.safety_gate: Do not convert the Noetix source-model audit, endless gait evidence, walk trace, high-control command plan, link poses, static support, dynamic stability, joint-control report, or inertial/collision report into hardware authority. Authoritative Moonrobo mass, inertia, collision tags, and an approved dry-run/hardware handoff must replace assumptions before any claim beyond simulation review.
primary_task.next_action: Use this task to review source-model, endless-gait, contact, walk-command, link-pose, static-support, dynamic-stability, joint-control, and inertial/collision evidence; then replace assumed mass/collision metadata or keep hardware denied.

visual_geometries.source_status: urdf-visual-mesh; bounds derived from referenced obj vertices

source_model.note: Sibling Moonrobo Noetix source model provides URDF joint limits and visual geometry, including a placeholder base mesh, but exposes no authoritative collision or inertial tags. Moonphys collision/inertia reports must therefore remain review-only until Moonrobo publishes those tags.

source_endless_gait.note: Finite Noetix walk exports are replay windows over this mathematically endless Moonrobo gait. A frame one cycle later repeats the support/contact phase while the body advances by the configured forward offset. This is simulation evidence only.

source_walk.note: Kinematic endless-walk trace for MoonSuite collaboration: Moonmoon terrain plus Moonrobo Noetix model references. This is simulation evidence only, not hardware authority.

high_control_limits.source_status: moonrobo-profile-limits; command plan is dry-run review evidence

source_walk_command.note: Moonrobo high-level walk command plan segments the Noetix finite trace prefix into dry-run approval windows that respect the sibling robot profile limits. It is not hardware authority and does not enable execution.
